title: LB-SPR tutorial
text: simulation data frame includes following columns time step: unfished_pop: length structure unfished population fished_pop: length structure fished population unfished_vul: estimated catch unfished population applying selectivity exp_catch: estimated catch fished population applying selectivity real_catch: observed catch absolute numbers relative_catch: observed catch scaled sum one

title: LB-SPR tutorial
text: quick example plot SPR confidence interval shown .
code: estimates <- result_lbspr$evaluation$estimates g <- estimates %>%   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = years, y = SPR)) +   ggplot2::geom_point() +   ggplot2::geom_line() +   ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(x = years, ymin = lower_spr, ymax = upper_spr, fill = "maroon2", alpha = 0.1)) +   ggplot2::theme_bw() +   ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")  g

text: first plot compares estimated catch fished unfished populations 2015. second compares corresponding population--length structures.

title: LB-SPR tutorial
code: catch_2015 <- result_lbspr$simulation$model_info %>%   dplyr::filter(year == 2015) %>%   dplyr::select(lengths, unfished_vul, exp_catch) %>%   tidyr::pivot_longer(!lengths, names_to = "variables", values_to = "values")  g <- catch_2015 %>%   ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = lengths, y = values, color = variables)) +   ggplot2::geom_point() +   ggplot2::geom_line() +   ggplot2::xlab("Lengths") +   ggplot2::ylab("Standardised relative catch") +   ggplot2::scale_color_manual(     name = "Catch Type",     values = c(       unfished_vul = "seagreen",       exp_catch = "tomato"     )   )  g

title: LIME tutorial
text: See LIME documentation parameter definitions. example biological-parameter list contains fields LB-SPR LIME. Remove LB-SPR-specific field. rec_variability_mean rec_variability_sd define mean standard deviation LIME’s recruitment-variability prior (SigRprior), preventing unrealistically variable recruitment estimates (Rudd Thorson, 2017). example values based Thorson et al. (2014).

title: LIME tutorial
text: Unlike LB-SPR, LIME requires selectivity priors penalty constrains year--year changes estimated fishing mortality (Rudd Thorson, 2017). , SL50 halfway smallest observed length class modal class. SL95 set SL50 * 1.15, following approach used Prince et al. (2022) maturation ogive. sigmaF uses default value 0.2 Rudd Thorson (2017).
code: summary_catch <- catch_data$long %>%   dplyr::select(MeanLength, catch) %>%   dplyr::group_by(MeanLength) %>%   dplyr::summarise(total_catch = sum(catch)) catch_mode <- summary_catch$MeanLength[which.max(summary_catch$total_catch)] sl50 <- median(min(summary_catch$MeanLength):catch_mode) sel_params <- list(   sl50 = sl50,   sl95 = sl50 * 1.15 )  exploitation_params <- list(   s50 = sel_params$sl50,   s95 = sel_params$sl95,   sigmaF = 0.2 ) exploitation_params #> $s50 #> [1] 12.5 #>  #> $s95 #> [1] 14.375 #>  #> $sigmaF #> [1] 0.2

title: LIME tutorial
text: age-structured model, LIME must told whether selectivity maturity supplied length age. list also sets steepness h = 0.7.
code: extra_lht_details <- list(   binwidth = 1,   selex_input = "length",   maturity_input = "length",   nseasons = 1,   nfleets = 1,   h = 0.7 )

title: LIME tutorial
text: simul = TRUE, wrapper returns following additional output time step: Observed catch--length Observed catch--length, scaled sum one Standardised fished unfished population--age structures Standardised estimated catch--length applying estimated selectivity fished population Standardised estimated catch--length applying estimated selectivity unfished population
code: # Find SL50 and SL95 prior iim_lime_logistic <- lbmstoolbox::LimeLbms$new(   bio_params,   exploitation_params,   catch_data ) lht_context <- iim_lime_logistic$build_lht_context(extra_lht_details) result_lime <- iim_lime_logistic$run(lht_context, simul = TRUE)

title: LIME tutorial
text: Results two components: evaluation, contains model estimates, simulation, contains additional output. latter also retains raw LIME output. estimates data frame also includes confidence intervals F, SPR, recruitment (R), lower_ upper_ prefixes.

text: LIME model-fitting chunks currently disabled. Matrix compatibility issue can otherwise interrupt rendering error function 'sexp_as_cholmod_sparse' provided package 'Matrix'. data-preparation parameter-setting chunks still run. toolbox provides unified interface two widely used length-based fisheries assessment methods: LB-SPR (Hordyk et al., 2015a, 2015b, 2016) LIME (Rudd Thorson, 2017). also introduces several enhancements improve usability output access: Common interface: models use high-level workflow. LB-SPR simulation output: addition standard estimates, wrapper runs LB-SPR’s internal simulator returns estimated fished unfished catch--length population--length structures. outputs available LB-SPR exposed standard results. LIME simulation output: bundled fork LIME modifies TMB template return unfished population structure. wrapper also returns estimated fished unfished catch--length fished unfished population--age structures. Uncertainty intervals: Confidence intervals returned SPR FM LB-SPR, SPR, F, R LIME.
